item.title: ASUS patches critical Control Center Express vulnerabilities in v1.7.29
item.description:
ASUS patches critical Control Center Express vulnerabilities in v1.7.29

ASUS released Control Center Express v1.7.29 to address three critical vulnerabilities that could allow remote attackers to gain administrative control of the management console and the devices it manages.

🔍 Overview

  • Control Center Express is a central dashboard used by IT administrators to monitor and remotely manage fleets of PCs.
  • The product is marketed to businesses and IT service providers and supports more than 200 ASUS business, workstation, and Corporate Stable Model motherboards.

⚙️ Fixed Vulnerabilities

CVE Severity Type Impact
CVE-2026-114202 Critical (CVSS 10.0) Hard‑coded cryptographic key Unauthenticated remote attacker can forge an authentication token and gain administrator privileges with no prerequisites
CVE-2026-114204 Critical Hard‑coded key Remote attacker with low privileges can forge a session token for a recently logged‑in account
CVE-2026-114205 Critical Authorization flaw Low‑privileged user can create an administrator account

🚀 Availability

  • Versions earlier than v1.7.29 are affected. The security bulletin lists versions through v1.7.27; the status of v1.7.28 is unclear.
  • Affected users should install v1.7.29, then update agents on managed devices via Select Function → Client Agent Updater and verify the agent versions.

📦 Related Updates

  • Control Center Enterprise and Control Center Datacenter received patches for CVE-2026-126574, a critical authorization flaw that lets a low‑privileged Viewer role change an administrator’s password.
  • Armoury Crate was updated to fix CVE-2026-112115, a high‑severity privilege escalation flaw affecting all versions up to 6.7.2.

💡 Why it matters

  • The unauthenticated remote exploit (CVE‑2026‑114202) provides full administrative control without any user interaction, representing a worst‑case scenario for enterprise IT environments.
  • Even the lower‑privilege flaws could enable attackers to elevate their access, potentially compromising large fleets of managed PCs.
  • Prompt patching is essential to maintain the integrity of the management console and the devices under its control.

#ASUS #Security #Vulnerabilities #ITManagement

Source: ASUS warns of critical hard-coded key flaw in Control Center Express

item.title: F5 Patches NGINX nginx2root Vulnerabilities Enabling Remote Code Execution
item.description:
F5 Patches NGINX nginx2root Vulnerabilities Enabling Remote Code Execution

F5 has released security updates for multiple NGINX vulnerabilities, including two critical flaws dubbed “nginx2root.” These vulnerabilities allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code remotely on vulnerable web servers and can be chained with a Linux kernel bug to gain root access to the underlying host.

Researchers at Xint, Wiz, Ikotas Labs, Metnir, and Rapid7 discovered the two primary HTTP/2 vulnerabilities independently. Xint researchers demonstrated that by chaining one of these flaws with a separate vulnerability in the Linux kernel’s SCTP subsystem, an attacker can escape an NGINX Docker container and gain root privileges.

🧩 How it works

The “nginx2root” vulnerabilities involve memory corruption and session management errors within the NGINX worker process:

  • CVE-2026-123007: A flow-control bug that causes memory corruption in an NGINX worker. It impacts versions 1.31.8 down to 1.9.5.
  • CVE-2026-123633: A use-after-free issue that occurs when NGINX accepts HTTP/2 connections and proxies them to a backend. When the worker runs low on connection slots, it may close an active connection and free memory that a request is still using.

⚙️ Key details

Vulnerability Description
CVE-2026-123007 Memory corruption flaw in NGINX worker via HTTP/2 flow-control.
CVE-2026-123633 Use-after-free vulnerability affecting HTTP/2 requests proxied to backends.
CVE-2026-118899 High-severity DoS flaw causing an infinite loop over TLS 1.3.
CVE-2026-121810 Use-after-free vulnerability affecting HTTP/3 reverse proxying.
CVE-2026-123634 Use-after-free vulnerability affecting DNS resolution with subrequests.
CVE-2026-113425 Use-after-free vulnerability affecting mail proxy authentication.

🚀 Availability

F5 has fixed these issues in the latest versions of NGINX Open Source and NGINX Plus. System administrators are recommended to upgrade immediately:

  • NGINX Open Source: Update to 1.30.7 (stable) or 1.31.9 (mainline).
  • NGINX Plus: Update to 37.0.8.1 or 37.3.0.1.

As a temporary mitigation for the two “nginx2root” flaws, administrators can disable HTTP/2, although this does not address the other vulnerabilities included in the security update.

💡 Why it matters

Exploitability depends heavily on specific server configurations. Security researcher Florian Roth notes that these flaws are exploitable in non-default configurations and may not be an imminent threat for most deployments. The vulnerabilities require HTTP/2 to be enabled on a reachable listener, and CVE-2026-123633 specifically requires NGINX to be proxying requests to a backend.

According to Censys, approximately 8.8 million NGINX services were potentially exposed to CVE-2026-123007 as of November 19, based on version numbers and HTTP/2 support. More than 511,000 previously exposed services have already been patched or mitigated.

#Cybersecurity #NGINX #InfoSec #Linux #CloudSecurity

Source: Critical NGINX ‘NGINX2Root’ bugs let attackers hijack servers

item.title: Microsoft releases Windows 11 KB5132057 November optional cumulative update
item.description:
Microsoft releases Windows 11 KB5132057 November optional cumulative update

Microsoft released the KB5132057 November optional cumulative update for Windows 11 versions 25H2 and 26H2, bringing 28 changes including improvements to Windows Search, Windows Hello, and the Run dialog. This preview update allows IT administrators to test improvements, bug fixes, and new features before the next Patch Tuesday release, and it will be the final non-security preview update released this year as operations wind down for the Western holidays.

🔍 Overview

KB5132057 is an optional non-security preview update that provides only quality improvements rather than security fixes. Installing this update will upgrade Windows 11 26H2 and 25H2 devices to builds 26300.10075 and 26200.10075, respectively. Microsoft also noted that a limited number of consumer and business devices might experience one additional restart during installation after a Secure Boot certificate update is applied.

⚙️ Key features and changes

  • Windows Search: Features a new WinUI 3-based Search Box experience that removes promotional content from web results for better resource efficiency and streamlined design. Search from This PC in File Explorer is now indexer-based, and inline actions let users complete common tasks directly from Windows Search.
  • Windows Hello: Includes improved facial recognition enabling sign-in in dark rooms after turning on the “Automatically adjust screen brightness during face recognition” setting.
  • Run Dialog: Adds the new Run dialog with a refreshed design and an almost instant time-to-show of 94 ms.
  • Accessibility: Users can now turn off accidentally triggered keyboard shortcuts for Sticky Keys, Filter Keys, or Toggle Keys directly from the appearing prompt.
  • Enterprise and Security: Web sign-in is now supported on Microsoft Entra hybrid-joined devices, allowing password-free lock screen sign-in via FIDO2 keys, phone passkeys, or Temporary Access Pass.
  • Bug Fixes: Resolves an issue where the File History restore interface might not find backups when a drive is selected as the backup location.
Feature / Component Description
Windows Search Box Built on WinUI 3, removes promotional web content for streamlined design.
Inline Actions Complete tasks like turning on dark mode/Bluetooth, adjusting brightness, or managing open windows directly from search.
Phone Link Integration Call or text contacts, and use “Find my phone” and “Do Not Disturb” actions if an Android phone is connected.
Windows Hello Improved facial recognition for signing into accounts in dark rooms.

🚀 Availability

  • Users can install the update by opening Windows Settings, clicking Windows Update, and clicking ‘Check for Updates’.
  • Because it is an optional update, users must click the “Download and install” link unless they have the “Get the latest updates as soon as they’re available” option enabled.
  • The preview update can also be manually downloaded and installed from the Microsoft Update Catalog.

#Windows11 #Microsoft #WindowsUpdate #TechNews

Source: Windows 11 KB5132057 update released with 28 changes and fixes

item.title: Hermes Memory UI Released for Agent Inspection
item.description:
Hermes Memory UI Released for Agent Inspection

The Read-only Hermes Agent plugin has been introduced for inspecting memory in the Hermes Dashboard and Hermes Desktop, providing a unified Python backend API alongside separate delivery artifacts.

🔍 Overview

  • Read-only Hermes Agent plugin for inspecting memory in Hermes Dashboard and Hermes Desktop.
  • The Dashboard and Desktop interfaces are separate delivery artifacts sharing only the profile-aware Python backend API.
  • The plugin is intentionally read-only and does not add, edit, replace, or remove memories.
  • Writes must go through Hermes’ memory and fact_store tools or provider classes to preserve validation, locking, mirroring, FTS, HRR vectors, and memory-bank maintenance.

🧩 Supported Memory Sources

Memory Source Description / Capabilities
Built-in memory (MEMORY.md, USER.md) Agent notes, environment facts, project conventions, user profile, and preferences. Works always.
Session search Explicit read-only search over previous Hermes sessions via session_search tool, with optional source/type filters (CLI, Telegram, cron, Discord, web, API).
Holographic memory Local SQLite fact store at $HERMES_HOME/memory_store.db tracking facts, categories, trust scores, retrieval counters, and timestamps.
Mem0 memory Read-only Mem0 Platform memories via provider config, including scopes, scores, timestamps, and metadata.
Honcho memory Read-only Honcho workspace, host, peer, and provider configuration state with user/AI peer cards, representations, conclusions, and context search.
Mnemosyne memory Read-only local SQLite store inspection for episodes, facts, instructions, gists, and graph rows, with explicit recall and injected-context preview.
Hindsight memory Read-only/query-only Hindsight provider configuration state with explicit recall and reflect actions, and contents view for memory units and retained source documents.
ByteRover memory Read-only ByteRover CLI (brv) project status and registered locations, supporting explicit BM25 search and optional query/synthesis action.

⚙️ Key Technical Details

  • Built-in memory view works always, while external memory provider sections show only when configured.
  • Dashboard is a web plugin with its own manifest, tracked browser bundle, and stylesheet (dashboard/).
  • Desktop plugin (desktop/plugin.js) is a standalone, uncompiled ESM disk plugin importing only the Hermes Desktop SDK, React, and the JSX runtime without requiring an npm build.
  • The Desktop plugin registers the /memory full-page route, a Memory sidebar item, and an Open Memory command-palette action.
  • Desktop requests use the plugin-scoped, profile-aware ctx.rest client reaching the same /api/plugins/hermes-memory-ui/ backend used by Dashboard.
  • The regular plugin must be installed and present in plugins.enabled so Hermes mounts dashboard/plugin_api.py.

🚀 Installation and Availability

  • Default profile lives at ~/.hermes, while a named profile lives at ~/.hermes/profiles/<name> (use hermes -p <name> and set HERMES_HOME="$HOME/.hermes/profiles/<name>").
  • Install directly from GitHub: hermes plugins install xraysight/hermes-memory-ui --enable.
  • To enable the Hermes Desktop interface, copy the disk plugin to $HERMES_HOME/desktop-plugins/hermes-memory-ui/plugin.js.
  • Hermes Desktop inventories the UI separately under Settings → Plugins.
  • Update existing installation using hermes plugins update hermes-memory-ui.

#HermesAgent #AIPlugins #MemoryManagement #DeveloperTools

Source: xraysight/hermes-memory-ui

item.title: ComfyUI-KJNodes Introduces Enhanced Set/Get Node Functionality
item.description:
ComfyUI-KJNodes Introduces Enhanced Set/Get Node Functionality

🔍 Overview

The ComfyUI-KJNodes project has recently undergone a significant update, introducing enhanced functionalities for Set/Get nodes within the ComfyUI framework. This update focuses on extending support to both legacy and nodes 2.0, alongside promoting cross-subgraph interconnectivity.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Backward Compatibility: The rewrite maintains compatibility with earlier versions, ensuring seamless integration with existing workflows.
  • Subgraph Functionality: Set/Get nodes now operate across parent and child subgraphs, facilitating broader interactions within multi-tiered structures.
  • New Operations:
    • Convert link to Set/Get using a right-click on any link midpoint.
    • Batch convert selected node outputs to Set/Get pairs.
    • The canvas right-click menu supports the conversion of outputs on selected nodes.
  • Key Shortcuts:
    • Ctrl+Shift+S: Add Set nodes.
    • Ctrl+Shift+G: Add Get nodes.
    • Ctrl+Shift+L: Toggle visibility of all connections.
  • Settings Enhancements: New settings for managing link visibility, keyboard shortcuts without conflicting with other actions, and sprite appearance based on connections.
  • Conversion Features: Right-clicking a SetNode adds a corresponding GetNode, and double-clicking a GetNode navigates to its paired SetNode.
  • Type and Color Update: Nodes now reflect type changes when inputs or outputs are disconnected, ensuring consistency in visual feedback.
  • Settings Structure: Settings have been reorganized under KJNodes > Set & Get and KJNodes > General categories for improved navigation.

💡 Why It Matters

This update enhances user interaction and workflow efficiency within the ComfyUI ecosystem. The integration of Set/Get functionalities across subgraphs and the addition of user-friendly features signifies an advancement in customization capabilities, empowering users to build more complex and interconnected AI pipelines.

🚀 Availability

To begin using these features, users should:

  1. Clone the custom_nodes repo to the custom_nodes folder.
  2. Install dependencies using pip install -r requirements.txt.

For portable installs, utilize:

1

custom_setup/ComfyUI_windows_portable-folder/python_embeded/python.exe -m pip install -r ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ComfyUI-KJNodes/requirements.txt

#ComfyUI #AIToolkit #KJNodes #SetGetNodes #Subgraphs #NodeOptimization

Source: kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes

item.title: Google rebrands Spark AI as Tasks, making it free and expanding availability
item.description:
Google rebrands Spark AI as Tasks, making it free and expanding availability

Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as “Tasks” and making it free to use. The update, powered by Google’s new Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model, brings the agentic capabilities originally introduced in May to a much broader audience.

🔍 Overview

Spark AI was first introduced in May but was previously restricted to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. The transition to “Tasks” in Gemini makes these capabilities available to all users in the US, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia, and India.

🧩 How it works

Users can access Tasks by opening Gemini and changing the toggle on the homepage from “Chat” to “Tasks.” The agent operates within a hardware-isolated virtual machine dedicated to the user’s account, ensuring it is never shared with other users. Users can provide instructions to Gemini while it completes tasks, and the AI will stop and request permission before executing more sensitive actions, such as purchasing an item.

⚙️ Key details

The feature allows the AI agent to perform various tasks, including:

Capability Details
Planning Create meal plans
Management Manage your calendar
Research Dig through emails to find recurring expenses
Communication Call businesses on your behalf
Transactions Purchase items with Google Pay
Access Sign into accounts that support Google Password Manager

US users receive access to additional features, such as having the AI agent call businesses to compare product pricing and check inventory. They can also assign Gemini tasks by emailing gemini@google.com or texting it.

🚀 Availability

The launch brings Spark’s capabilities to users in the US, Canada, Japan, Korea, Australia, and India. Tasks in Gemini joins a broader category of agentic AI features that have emerged over the past year, alongside competitors like Claude Duet, OpenAI’s Dots, and Meta’s Muse.

#Google #Gemini #AIAgents #Productivity #SparkAI

Source: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free

item.title: Eido 0.0.2 Adds Browser Automation and Localization to Native AI Workspace
item.description:
Eido 0.0.2 Adds Browser Automation and Localization to Native AI Workspace

Eido 0.0.2 is now available for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. This update introduces browser and desktop automation capabilities, expanded localization options, and interface refinements for the native AI workspace built on Zed and the official pi agent.

🌐 Localization Updates

The interface now supports English and Simplified Chinese. Users can select Follow System, English, or 简体中文 at the top of the Settings menu. While common Eido controls and menus are localized, user content, code, model output, and tool identifiers remain unchanged.

🖥️ Interface Refinements

Several visual and usability improvements have been applied to the workspace:

  • Interface and conversation text default to 16px.
  • Ordinary completed tasks no longer leave a detached “Run finished” label; important status messages stay aligned with the input area.
  • Existing custom font preferences are preserved.
  • Users can drag the empty area in the top toolbar to move a non-fullscreen window on macOS.

🌐 Browser and Computer Use

The update introduces experimental features for extending tasks to websites and desktop applications. These capabilities are disabled by default and require separate DeepSeek service configuration. The release includes Chromium and its desktop driver. Users can also connect an existing Poki MCP installation to supported iPhone workflows, though Poki and device preparation are separate setup steps. Automation compatibility varies by website, application, and device.

To enable Computer Use, users must update global settings and grant specific macOS permissions:

  1. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security.
  2. Allow Eido under Accessibility and Screen & System Audio Recording (called Screen Recording on some macOS versions).
  3. Restart Eido.

These permissions allow input and window capture. Note that replacing a locally signed build can require re-enabling these permissions, and permission previously granted to a standalone Cua Driver does not apply to Eido.

🧩 Workflow and Configuration

The update retains pi’s public configuration and authentication interfaces while updating runtime adaptation. Key workflow features include:

  • Reference relevant files with @ and attach supporting material.
  • Continue earlier tasks with their saved context.
  • Review proposed file changes in the native editor before accepting them.
  • Search and fetch sources, inspect saved evidence, extract PDF/image text, and connect requirements with proposed changes and checks.

Model and thinking controls are located beside the composer in AI → pi Models & Credentials. Configuration and task history are stored outside the application bundle and are preserved during local updates.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Bundled Agent: pi 1.5.2
  • Signing Status: Locally signed; has not been notarized by Apple.
  • Release Assets: Include SHA-256 checksums, Eido source, and corresponding source for the native components.

#Eido #Zed #AIWorkspace #BrowserAutomation #macOS #PiAgent

Source: tony3liu/eido

item.title: Google Updates Gemini AI with New Models and Multi-Tiered Subscription Plans
item.description:
Google Updates Gemini AI with New Models and Multi-Tiered Subscription Plans

Google has updated its AI ecosystem with the introduction of the Gemini 4 model family and a restructured subscription framework. These developments include the launch of the Gemini 4 Argon, Hydrogen, and Carbon models, alongside a new functional design language called Neural Expressive.

⚙️ Subscription Tiers and Model Access

The update introduces three distinct Google AI plans with varying levels of access and usage limits. Users can manage their consumption through limits that refresh every 5 hours until a weekly cap is reached, or by purchasing additional AI credits.

Plan Monthly Cost Usage Limits Model Access
Google AI Plus Not specified 2x higher than Free Gemini 4 Argon, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Pro model, Flash-Lite
Google AI Pro Not specified 4x higher than Free Access to Pro model features
Google AI Ultra $199.99 20x higher than AI Pro Highest access to Gemini 4 Carbon, Argon, and Hydrogen

🧩 Functional Features

New capabilities focus on both complex task management and creative content generation:

  • Gemini 4 Argon: Built to manage and complete complex tasks from start to finish.
  • Gemini Live: Now integrated into chat sessions, allowing users to switch between talking and typing.
  • Gemini Omni: Functions as a video-focused version of Nano Banana.
  • Neural Expressive: A new functional design language created for the AI era.
  • Creative Reimaging: Users can show Gemini their surroundings and use the phrase “reimagine this” to create new visuals with Nano Banana.
  • Personalized Digest: The platform now offers a Daily Brief to help users start their day.

🚀 Agentic Development and Code

The update includes tools for building and governing autonomous AI entities through Google Antigravity, an agentic development platform. Users can utilize these autonomous agents to write, test, and deploy code. The Google AI Ultra plan provides the highest rate limits to agent models within the Antigravity platform and includes first access to features like Tasks in Gemini.

🌎 Availability and Restrictions

Google has expanded the geographic reach of its AI services, though access is limited to users aged 18 and older for Google AI plans and Gemini for Gmail and Docs.

  • Google AI Plus: Available in more than 160 countries and territories.
  • Google AI Pro and Ultra: Available in more than 150 countries.
  • Project Genie: Available in more than 140 countries.
  • YouTube Premium: The individual plan is available in over 40 countries.
  • Regional Specifics: Access to the Gemini 4 Carbon model and Nano Banana Pro in AI Mode is restricted to select countries.

#Gemini #GoogleAI #AIagents #Gemini4 #MachineLearning

Source: Gemini – Your AI assistant from Google

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model for Enhanced Search Performance
item.description:
Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen Model for Enhanced Search Performance

Google has released Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a new model designed to provide more helpful answers to complex queries, including multi-part questions, highly specific requests, and those containing hard-to-understand typos. According to Google, the model can break down questions and address each individual part in its responses. Robby Stein, VP of product at Google Search, says the update is now the default model in AI Mode and is being used for difficult questions in AI Overviews.

🔍 Overview

Google says the new model delivers significant leaps in both speed and intelligence compared to Gemini Flash 3.8. Stein describes Gemini 4 Hydrogen as “the biggest model upgrade to Search yet.” The model’s performance reportedly matches or outperforms competing models in its class, such as Claude Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Terra.

🧩 How it works

To improve information retrieval and language understanding, the model employs several new processing techniques:

  • Simultaneous Queries: The model conducts simultaneous queries across all relevant subtopics to provide a wider range of links in its responses.
  • Improved Language Understanding: Understanding has been improved across all supported AI Mode languages.
  • Breakdown Capability: The model addresses complex questions by breaking them down and responding to each component.

⚙️ Key details

Responses from Gemini 4 Hydrogen now feature a broader range of visuals, including images, comparison tables, graphs, and maps. In one example provided by Stein, the AI generated an interactive animated driving simulation to explain how phones locate specific highway lanes in areas without cell service.

Users are also provided with expanded thinking level options:

  • Low
  • Medium
  • High
  • xhigh (New)

🚀 Availability

Starting today, Gemini 4 Hydrogen is available in the following products and services:

  • Google Search and the Gemini app
  • All tiers of Google AI Studio and the Gemini API
  • Gemini for business
  • Google Antigravity (available for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers)

#Google #Gemini #ArtificialIntelligence #Search #Gemini4Hydrogen

Source: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions

item.title: Adobe Expands Creative Cloud with New AI Editing Tools
item.description:
Adobe Expands Creative Cloud with New AI Editing Tools

Adobe announced new AI capabilities for Creative Cloud apps and its Firefly platform at the Max event, aiming to speed up design and editing tasks.

🔍 Overview

  • Adobe is expanding Creative Cloud apps and Firefly AI platform with new capabilities.
  • Announcements include automatic removal of objects, blemishes, and distractions in Premiere, Photoshop, and Lightroom, plus new generative AI tools and collaborative experiences.

🧩 How it works

  • Premiere Generative Remove (beta)
    • Mask an object, click Remove; Premiere fills the area with realistic detail using generative AI while surrounding footage stays untouched.
  • Photoshop updated Remove Tool
    • Better at detecting and reconstructing surrounding elements such as reflections, shadows, and footprints.
  • Photoshop Quick Compare
    • Before‑and‑after split‑screen slider to review changes without switching layers.
  • Photoshop Relight
    • Add and position new light sources to dynamically adjust hue and brightness.
  • Lightroom blemish removal
    • Single‑tap skin retouch on desktop (previously mobile only).
  • Lightroom Open Eyes (public beta)
    • Replaces closed eyes with natural‑looking open eyes using a reference photo from the library.
  • Premiere new sound editing tools
    • Clean messy recordings and separate dialogue, music, ambience, and sound effects into individual tracks.
  • Firefly Quick Actions
    • Ready‑to‑use workflows for creating video thumbnails and product ads, now generally available.
  • Firefly Design
    • Combined space for illustration, image editing, animation, 3D, and print (beta).
  • Firefly Graph
    • Helps creators build and iterate on custom, repeatable workflows.
  • Firefly Builder (private beta)
    • Tool for prototyping websites and apps.

⚙️ Key details

  • Generative Media tool introduced earlier this year is now generally available.
  • Color Mode color editing experience, launched in beta in April, is now generally available.
  • Features are part of Adobe’s broader expansion of Creative Cloud and Firefly AI platform.

🚀 Availability

  • Premiere Generative Remove – beta.
  • Photoshop Remove Tool – updated now.
  • Photoshop Quick Compare and Relight – newly added.
  • Lightroom blemish removal – coming to desktop.
  • Lightroom Open Eyes – public beta.
  • Firefly Quick Actions – generally available.
  • Firefly Design, Graph – beta; Firefly Builder – private beta.
  • Generative Media and Color Mode – generally available.

#Adobe #CreativeCloud #AI #VideoEditing

Source: Photoshop, Lightroom, and Premiere are making it easier to remove things

item.title: Apple pushes Siri toward agentic AI with new app integration and fine‑grained controls
item.description:
Apple pushes Siri toward agentic AI with new app integration and fine‑grained controls

Apple is updating Siri to become more agentic, adding fine‑grained control over its own apps and integration with third‑party services.

🔍 Overview

  • Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that CEO John Ternus is pressuring AI czar Craig Federighi to accelerate the Siri roadmap.
  • Federighi has delivered a functional version of Siri AI on an incredibly short timeline, but the company acknowledges it is not keeping pace with rivals.
  • Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic and to enable ongoing tasks rather than single‑step commands.

⚙️ Upcoming Features

  • Fine‑grained control of first‑party apps – Siri will be able to rotate and crop images in Photos and organize Safari tabs. Expected with iOS 27.3.
  • Third‑party app integration – Siri will place orders through Grubhub, book reservations through OpenTable, and similar actions. Expected in the Spring following iOS 27.3.

📅 Timeline

Feature Expected Release
First‑party app control (Photos, Safari) iOS 27.3
Third‑party app integration (Grubhub, OpenTable) Spring after iOS 27.3

💡 Why it matters

  • Competitors such as OpenAI’s Dots, Meta’s Muse, and Grok can keep track of goals and continue pursuing objectives without the user initiating every step.
  • Apple aims to give Siri similar agentic capabilities, allowing it to perform ongoing tasks and manage objectives, a direction the company may reach as early as next year.

#Apple #Siri #AIagents #VoiceAssistants

Source: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic

item.title: Compromise of Eight eMudhra Intermediate CA Certificates
item.description:
Compromise of Eight eMudhra Intermediate CA Certificates

The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised, affecting certificates that chain to roots trusted by several major root programs and downstream trust stores.

⚙️ Key details

  • The compromise involves eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates.
  • These certificates chain to roots trusted by:
    • Mozilla
    • Microsoft
    • Apple
    • Chrome root programs
    • Many downstream trust stores

🚀 Availability

Software that bundles trusted certificates requires updates. Current updates include:

Software/Package Version
uv 0.13.4
pip 26.2.2
certifi 2026.10.19

Additionally, Linux distributions are required to update their ca-certificates packages.

#eMudhra #Cybersecurity #Certificates #CACompromise

Source: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise

item.title: Google pushes Android 17 developer preview with battery and privacy enhancements
item.description:
Google pushes Android 17 developer preview with battery and privacy enhancements

The Android ecosystem is busy this weekend as Google released a fresh update to the Android 17 developer preview, focusing on better battery life, background‑process control, and new privacy tweaks.

🔍 Overview

  • Android 17 developer preview arrives with a revamped battery settings menu.
  • Users can now see which background services consume the most power.
  • A new Private Space folder lets you hide specific apps from the app drawer without uninstalling them.
  • Notification snooze lets you silence alerts for one or two hours.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Battery Management
    • Revamped battery settings menu.
    • Visibility of power‑hungry background services.
  • App Privacy
    • Hide apps in the Private Space folder.
    • Google aims to help users find apps that behave badly.
  • Notification Control
    • Swipe a notification to the side for a snooze option.

📱 Additional Android Updates

  • Google Maps – Minor update adds the ability to save multiple custom routes as home‑screen shortcuts.
  • Google Photos – Refresh includes a faster search index for quicker object and person searches.
  • Security Patch – October security patch released for all supported Pixel devices, fixing three major flaws that could allow unauthorized media‑file access. Other manufacturers (OnePlus, Motorola) expected to roll it out by mid‑next week.

🚀 Availability

  • The Android 17 preview is now available for developers.
  • Google plans to open the beta to more devices soon.
  • Reminder: Back up your data before installing major system updates; keeping copies of photos and documents is always wise.

💡 Why It Matters

  • Improved battery visibility helps users extend device runtime.
  • Enhanced privacy controls give users more granular app management.
  • Faster search in Google Photos and custom route shortcuts in Maps streamline everyday tasks.
  • The October security patch addresses critical vulnerabilities, reinforcing device security across the ecosystem.

#android #android17 #mobileupdates #privacy #security

Source: Android Daily News: October 10, 2026 – Latest Updates and Releases - thetechpapa

item.title: Eventbrite Adds Autocomplete to Search Events

item.title: ChatGPT Updates with GPT-5 and GPT-5.5 Models
item.description:
ChatGPT Updates with GPT-5 and GPT-5.5 Models

ChatGPT has updated its capabilities with the introduction of GPT-5 and GPT-5.5 models, expanding its utility as a general reasoning and generation assistant.

⚙️ Key details

  • Model Family: GPT-5 and GPT-5.5 provide substantially improved reasoning over earlier versions.
  • Deep Research Mode: Autonomously browses dozens of web sources to synthesise a structured report with citations.
  • Projects: Maintains persistent context and custom instructions across conversations to accumulate memory for ongoing research or writing projects.
  • Custom GPTs Marketplace: Offers pre-configured specialist assistants for specific tasks, industries, and knowledge domains.
  • Multi-modal Input: Handles text, images, files, PDFs, and voice.
  • Additional Integration: Includes web browsing for real-time information and DALL-E image generation within the interface.

🚀 Availability

  • Free Tier: Provides meaningful access to GPT-5.5 Instant.
  • Plus Tier: Costs $20 per month and unlocks the full model range, Advanced Voice, file analysis, and higher usage limits.

💡 Why it matters

By mid-2026, ChatGPT had adopted 500 million-plus weekly active users, becoming the most widely used AI assistant in the world. The Deep Research mode specifically moves the tool from answering individual questions to conducting multi-source research on behalf of the user.

#ChatGPT #GPT-5 #AI #GenerativeAI

Source: Tech Tuesday: The complete guide to AI chatbots and knowledge tools in 2026

item.title: OpenAI Expands Platform with Enterprise Tools and Voice API Amid Subscription Pauses
item.description:
OpenAI Expands Platform with Enterprise Tools and Voice API Amid Subscription Pauses

OpenAI has launched a series of updates to its platform, including new specialized enterprise tools and advanced voice capabilities, while managing service strain by pausing select high-tier subscriptions.

⚙️ Key details

OpenAI has introduced several new tools designed for enterprise and developer use cases:

Feature Function
ChatGPT for Financial Services Specialized for market research and financial modeling.
Data Agent Feature in ChatGPT Work that turns company data into dashboards and insights on request.
GPT-Live-1 API and Platform tool for full-duplex bidirectional voice conversations.
Library Integrations Native integration for Dropbox, Box, and SharePoint across ChatGPT and ChatGPT Work.

🚀 Availability

The rollout of these features and service availability are as follows:

  • Subscription Pause: New subscriptions to the $200 Pro plan on Astra are currently paused due to system strain. Existing accounts remain unaffected, and all other plans and the API remain available.
  • Rollout Schedule: The native integration of Dropbox, Box, and SharePoint is rolling out this week to paid users.
  • Platform Access: GPT-Live-1 is available on the API and OpenAI Platform, providing bidirectional voice with increased control over how agents speak and act.

🔍 Overview

In addition to product releases, OpenAI is facing regulatory scrutiny and preparing for future announcements:

  • Managed Agents: The company plans to unveil Managed Agents for SMB customers at OpenAI DevDay, which will compete with Meta’s upcoming “Shared Agents” for Muse.
  • Senate Probe: A Senate disaster management subcommittee, led by Sen. Josh Hawley, is investigating OpenAI’s handling of the Hugging Face breach, describing the company’s actions as reckless.

💡 Why it matters

These developments signify OpenAI’s push into industry-specific solutions and more natural voice interfaces while highlighting the infrastructure challenges and regulatory oversight associated with scaling highly popular AI services.

#OpenAI #ChatGPT #EnterpriseAI

Source: AI News. September 11, 2026

item.title: CC Switch Launches as Cross-Platform Manager for AI Coding Agents
item.description:
CC Switch Launches as Cross-Platform Manager for AI Coding Agents

CC Switch is a newly released cross-platform desktop manager designed to configure and switch between various AI coding agents and tools. Built with Tauri 2, it supports Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.

🔍 Overview

CC Switch serves as an all-in-one manager for a variety of agentic tools and models, including:

Tool Description
Claude Code AI coding assistant
Claude Desktop AI desktop application
Codex Coding agent
Gemini CLI Command line interface
Grok Build Development build tool
OpenCode Coding tool
OpenClaw Coding agent
Hermes Agent Agentic tool

⚙️ Key Details

CC Switch facilitates integration with Kimi K3, Moonshot AI’s model with 2.8 trillion parameters, native vision, and a 1-million-token context window. The manager also supports integration with several API relay service providers:

  • PackyCode: Provides relay services for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and others. Users can use promo code “cc-switch” during their first recharge for a 10% discount.
  • ZetaAPI: Focuses on model fidelity and offers pay-as-you-go billing with a 10x compensation guarantee for quality inconsistencies. Users can use promo code “CC-SWITCH” for a 10% discount on the first top-up.
  • APINEBULA: An enterprise-grade aggregation platform that provides access to Claude, GPT, and Gemini models. Users can use promo code “ccswitch” for a 10% discount on the first recharge.

🚀 Availability

CC Switch is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux. The official website for the application is ccswitch.io.

#CCSwitch #AIAgents #CodingTools #Tauri

Source: farion1231/cc-switch
